chapter: Dreamland and the Tuxedo dance hall
title: Dreamland as a New York-style cabaret
summary: He describes the Dreamland cabaret as the first of its kind, low ceiling, lights and six entertainers, and the interviewer turns to older cabarets with high bandstands.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: What was the Dreamland? Was that the Taxi or a Nickel dance, Penn Center dance hall? No,

The first cabaret was run on the style of the New York styles. They remodeled it was a high ceiling and they made the ceiling low with all the beautiful little lights all around and in the popular place.
The floor shows are singers and dancers.
Oh, yeah. They had six entertainers.
